prompt: Bug report from a user: "`elevation.steepest_grade()` returns 0.18 for a track whose steepest stretch climbs 18 m over 100 m. The README and the docstring say it returns a percentage, so I expected 18.0." Find the cause and fix it.
bash_commands: git status --short && git ls-files && grep -rn "steepest_grade" . --include=* -r 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^./.git/"
cat -n src/trailhead/elevation.py && sed -n 35,60p README.md && grep -n "steep" -A12 tests/test_elevation.py && sed -n 40,60p src/trailhead/report.py

sed -n 1,70p src/trailhead/report.py; echo ----; cat tests/test_elevation.py; echo ----; grep -rn "steep\|grade" tests src | grep -v "^src/trailhead/elevation.py"; echo ----; cat pyproject.toml | head -40
cat tests/conftest.py; echo ----; cat tests/test_report.py | head -40; echo ----; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

cat >> tests/test_elevation.py <<'EOF'


def test_steepest_grade_is_a_percentage(make_track):
    # 100 m due north, then an 18 m climb: a gradient of 18 %.
    run_deg = math.degrees(0.100 / EARTH_RADIUS_KM)
    track = make_track((0, 0, 500), (run_deg, 0, 518))
    assert steepest_grade(track) == pytest.approx(18.0, abs=1e-6)


def test_steepest_grade_takes_the_steepest_downhill_leg(make_track):
    run_deg = math.degrees(0.100 / EARTH_RADIUS_KM)
    track = make_track((0, 0, 500), (run_deg, 0, 505), (2 * run_deg, 0, 475))
    assert steepest_grade(track) == pytest.approx(30.0, abs=1e-6)


def test_steepest_grade_skips_repeated_points(make_track):
    run_deg = math.degrees(0.100 / EARTH_RADIUS_KM)
    track = make_track((0, 0, 500), (0, 0, 500), (run_deg, 0, 505))
    assert steepest_grade(track) == pytest.approx(5.0, abs=1e-6)
EOF
